Name: Dr. Sarah Lin
Bio: Dr. Lin is a leading researcher in brain-computer interfaces (BCI) and affective computing. She directs the Psychophysiology Lab at CUK, focusing on multi-modal biosignal integration, EEG oscillations, and prefrontal executive control mapping.

Name: Dr. Marcus Vance
Bio: Dr. Vance specializes in autonomic regulation, virtual reality stress paradigms, and heart rate variability (HRV) biofeedback systems. His research explores the coupling between cardiac rhythms and emotional regulation.
